proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ A B C D E F p hABC hD hE hF hDB hDC hEC hEA hFA hFB h1 h2 h3
  obtain ⟨r, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hD
  obtain ⟨s, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hE
  obtain ⟨t, rfl⟩ := mem_affineSpan_pair_iff_exists_lineMap_eq.mp hF
  have hr : r ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hDB
  have hs : s ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hEC
  have ht : t ≠ 0 := by rintro rfl; simp at hFA
  have ceva : r / (1 - r) * (s / (1 - s)) * (t / (1 - t)) = 1 := by
    let T : Affine.Triangle ℝ P := ⟨![A, B, C], affineIndependent_iff_not_collinear_set.mpr hABC⟩
    let R : Fin 3 → ℝ := ![r, s, t]
    have hR : ∀ i, R i ≠ 0 := by
      intro i; fin_cases i
      exacts [hr, hs, ht]
    have hp : ∀ i : Fin 3, p ∈ line[ℝ, T.points i, AffineMap.lineMap (T.points (i + 1)) (T.points (i + 2)) (R i)] := by
      intro i; fin_cases i
      exacts [h1, h2, h3]
    have := Affine.Triangle.prod_div_one_sub_eq_one_of_mem_line_point_lineMap hR hp
    rw [Fin.prod_univ_three] at this
    exact this
  have hBC : dist B C ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [dist_eq_zero] at h; subst h; apply hABC; simpa using collinear_pair ℝ A B
  have hCA : dist C A ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [dist_eq_zero] at h; subst h; apply hABC
    rw [Set.insert_comm]; simpa using collinear_pair ℝ B C
  have hAB : dist A B ≠ 0 := by
    intro h; rw [dist_eq_zero] at h; subst h; apply hABC; simpa using collinear_pair ℝ A C
  rw [dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right, dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right, dist_left_lineMap, dist_lineMap_right]
  simp only [Real.norm_eq_abs]
  have e1 : |r| * dist B C / (|1 - r| * dist B C) = |r / (1 - r)| := by
    rw [abs_div]; field_simp
  have e2 : |s| * dist C A / (|1 - s| * dist C A) = |s / (1 - s)| := by
    rw [abs_div]; field_simp
  have e3 : |t| * dist A B / (|1 - t| * dist A B) = |t / (1 - t)| := by
    rw [abs_div]; field_simp
  rw [e1, e2, e3, ← abs_mul, ← abs_mul, ceva, abs_one]
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] (A B C D E F p : P), ¬Collinear ℝ ({A, B, C} : Set P) → D ∈ line[ℝ, B, C] → E ∈ line[ℝ, C, A] → F ∈ line[ℝ, A, B] → D ≠ B → D ≠ C → E ≠ C → E ≠ A → F ≠ A → F ≠ B → p ∈ line[ℝ, A, D] → p ∈ line[ℝ, B, E] → p ∈ line[ℝ, C, F] → dist B D / dist D C * (dist C E / dist E A) * (dist A F / dist F B) = 1
